draft:
Meridian Capital today announced the completion of its acquisition of Lumen Specialty Chemicals (the "Company"), a leading European producer of high-purity specialty chemicals for the electronics, pharmaceutical, and advanced materials industries.

Headquartered in Frankfurt, the Company operates three production facilities across Germany and Belgium and employs approximately 850 people. It supplies more than 600 customers worldwide, with particular strength in ultra-high-purity solvents used in semiconductor wafer fabrication and pharmaceutical active ingredient manufacturing.

The Company will be led by its existing Chief Executive, Dr. Annika Brandt. Meridian intends to support an acceleration of the Company's expansion strategy, with a focus on the Asian electronics market and on selective acquisitions in adjacent specialty chemical categories.

The transaction represents the eighth investment from Meridian's European Industrials strategy. Total invested capital from the Meridian platform in the specialty chemicals sector now exceeds EUR 2 billion across the firm's global investments.
